commands_run: $snap = <snapshots\branch-risk-analyst>; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $snap; Copy-Item risk-analysis.md,risk-analyst-pick.json $snap; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force <receipts>; Get-ChildItem $snap
problems_and_friction: No protocol was given for coordinating with the two sibling agents writing concurrently, so I avoided collisions by writing only role-prefixed files (risk-analysis.md, risk-analyst-pick.json) and never editing shared files. The market-researcher sibling had already finished, so I mirrored its small pick.json convention for the synthesizer. No web access meant vendor facts (EU regions, pricing/contract terms) are from knowledge as of early 2026 and flagged for verification.
context_understood: From brief.md: evaluate Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho CRM for Brightline, a 40-person Dublin ad agency; my role was the risk angle (GDPR/data residency, lock-in/exit, migration, hidden costs, support) with a risk register and a single vendor pick plus confidence.
